question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the word ‘Ravishing’ from the given sentence.

The architect designed a stunning skyscraper with a sophisticated structural system.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Stunning**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Ravishing"** means extremely attractive or beautiful; captivating. (मोहक)

 
 
• **Example: **She looked ravishing in her evening gown at the gala.
 
 

 
• **"Stunning" **also refers to something that is extremely impressive or attractive; it is synonymous with ravishing in this context. (आकर्षक)

 
 
• **Example: **The sunset over the ocean was absolutely stunning, leaving everyone in awe.
 
 

 
• Hence, we can infer that the most appropriate synonym for **'Ravishing' **in the given sentence is **'Stunning'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Stunning**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Sophisticated **(जटिल): Highly developed and refined in complexity or design.
 
 
• **Example:** The new smartphone model features a sophisticated design that appeals to tech-savvy consumers.
 
 

 
• **Skyscraper **(गगनचुंबी इमारत): A very tall building of many stories.
 
 
• **Example: **The city's skyline is dominated by skyscrapers, each vying for attention with its unique architecture.
 
 

 
• **System** (प्रणाली): A set of things working together as parts of a mechanism or an interconnecting network.
 
 
• **Example:** The new railway system has significantly improved public transport in the city.
